Israeli loyalists in the US get indignant at the word "genocide," even as their top leaders and elected officials in Tel Aviv have been making classic genocidal statements and vows like this one for more than two years. The best case against them are their own words and actions:


ערוץ כנסת (@KnessetT)

"בג'נין אין אזרחים חפים מפשע, בג'נין אין ילדים תמימים" - ח"כ יצחק קרויזר מתייחס להרג המשפחה הפלסטינית ע"י כוחות הביטחון: "אני מגבה את לוחמי צה"ל בכל סיטואציה, גם אם המחיר האגבי הוא ילדים או נשים"

This little trick -- named The Barak Ravid Tactic, after the Israeli media operative who launders it -- has been used repeatedly.

We hear reports of Trump and Netanyahu diverging, Trump negotiating a peace: all a ruse that enables war.

Let's hope there's an exception now:


Ryan Grim (@ryangrim)

Isreali media reporting that Netanyahu expects a ceasefire announcement from Trump this Saturday. Translation: Ground invasion coming this weekend.



— https://nitter.net/ryangrim/status/203689529109

There's an orchestrated campaign to decree Hasan Piker off-limits in decent society by branding him an anti-Semite.

What has he said that's anti-Semitic, with full quotes?

I've had critiques of Hasan, but this just shows how every influential Israel critic is branded a bigot:


AIPAC 🇺🇸🇮🇱 (@AIPAC)

‘If you think America deserved 9/11 and Zionists are rabid neo-Nazis, we’d be proud to have you on our show.’

Thanks for sharing.



— https://nitter.net/AIPAC/status/2036859307971551582#m

I simply don't believe that Jews are a uniquely persecuted victim group, being "purged" from western power centers like business, media, entertainment politics. It's laughable.

Those who get angriest about this spent years mocking victimhood narratives from every other group.


Jesse Brown (@JesseBrown)
